title: Collect 5 different shades of green in one photo
proof: At least five visibly different green natural things (leaves, moss, grass) in one frame.

title: Be outside for golden hour and catch the light on a tree
proof: Warm, low sunlight hitting a tree or plants.

title: Walk to the nearest natural water and photograph it
proof: A lake, river, sea, pond, or stream, photographed outdoors.

title: Find a bird near water and photograph them together
proof: A bird and a body of water (pond, river, lake, fountain, sea) in the same photo.
